newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU oilseeds aid cut by five percent.
newsitem.headline: EU oilseeds aid cut by five percent.

text.p: The European Union's cereals management committee on Thursday cut the rate of aid for oilseed producers by five per cent, a Commission official said on Friday.
"The EU price was thirteen per cent higher than the predicted aid rate of 433.5 ecus per hectare based on a reference price 196.8 ecus per hectare.
"A franchise (gap) of 8 per cent is permitted and the difference represents the rate cut," the official said.
EU oilseed plantings did not exceed the bilateral Blair House agreement with the U.S., the cereals management committee was told, the EU official said.
"The figures were presented by the Commission and no penalties will apply for producers," the offcial said.
Under the 1992 Blair House agreement EU subsidised opilseed plantings cannot exceed 5.482 million hectares less ten percent compulsory set-aside.
